instruction: Transfer all PDFs attached to the 'Paper Recommendation' email in Thunderbird to the Google Drive root directory.

result.query: title contains '.pdf' and trashed = false and 'root' in parents

metadata.explanation: Task requires uploading all PDF attachments from 'Paper Recommendation' email to Google Drive. The evaluator uses a composite getter that extracts PDF attachment filenames from the Thunderbird email and queries Google Drive for uploaded PDFs. The metric verifies: 1) the email exists in Thunderbird, 2) the email contains PDF attachments, and 3) all PDF attachment filenames from the email are present in Google Drive's root folder. This ensures PDFs came from the correct email source.

llm_judge_reasons: Semantic logic is correct: Thunderbird getter extracts actual PDF attachment filenames from the 'Paper Recommendation' email using mailbox parsing, Google Drive getter queries for uploaded PDFs in root folder
Coverage is complete: Evaluator verifies all three requirements: 1) email exists in Thunderbird, 2) email contains PDF attachments, 3) all PDF attachments are uploaded to Google Drive root
Metric comparison logic is robust: Uses set difference to verify all email PDFs are present in Google Drive, with filename normalization (case-insensitive, whitespace-stripped) for reliable matching
Data flow is correct: Composite getter properly combines Thunderbird email data with Google Drive file data, metric correctly compares attachment names vs uploaded filenames
Previous f-string bugs have been fixed: Now uses .format() method for variable substitution (line 80), error handling is correct
Minor implementation note: Dynamic sys.path import is not ideal but should work at runtime
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider refactoring dynamic import to use env.controller or official framework APIs if available for better maintainability
